Recent (~46%) base rates for factory coins are poor, and this one is a single-cluster distribution, not broad demand. The recent 54% gain looks like the same concentrated buyers running the price, not independent interest that will persist.

I see no case strong enough to outweigh the base rates. My recommendation is to skip this coin.
